description: Defines an abstract class 'DeviceAwareSessionContext' that manages session context information for devices, including device and tenant IDs, device info, profile, session info, and connection status. Contains methods for updating device info, handling profile updates, and checking if the device uses Sparkplug protocol.

classes.name: DeviceAwareSessionContext
classes.description: An abstract class managing device session context, including device and tenant IDs, device info, profile, session info, and connection status. Provides methods for updating device info, handling profile updates, and checking Sparkplug protocol usage.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID associated with the session.

methods.name: setDeviceInfo
methods.description: Sets device information and updates device and tenant IDs accordingly.

methods.name: onDeviceProfileUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to the device profile and session info, updating device type.

methods.name: onDeviceUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to device info and optional device profile.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the session is currently connected.

methods.name: isSparkplug
methods.description: Determines if the device profile uses Sparkplug protocol based on transport configuration.
